title: Brian Schottenheimer says he's "elated" to have Joe Milton on Cowboys' practice squad

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer says he's "elated" to have Joe Milton on Cowboys' practice squad
sources.description: When the Cowboys waived quarterback Joe Milton, they knew they wanted him back on the practice squad, but they weren't sure if another team would claim him on waivers, or persuade him to join a different practice squad.
